query:
SELECT s.id, s.date, s.aTimeWorkerId, s.aTimeStartTime, s.aTimeEndTime,
       s.bTimeWorkerId, s.bTimeStartTime, s.bTimeEndTime,
       s.cTimeWorkerId, s.cTimeStartTime, s.cTimeEndTime,
       w.name
FROM schedules s
JOIN workers w ON (s.aTimeWorkerId = w.id OR s.bTimeWorkerId = w.id OR s.cTimeWorkerId = w.id)
WHERE w.name = '전민서'
ORDER BY s.date DESC
LIMIT 20;
